text:
The town council met on Tuesday to discuss the new cycle lanes.
<hl>Since the lanes opened in March, cycling to the town centre has doubled, according to counts published by the council's transport office.</hl> Some shop owners say parking has become harder, while others report more customers on foot and by bike.

Anyone else think the new phone design is a step backwards?
<hl>Honestly, round corners are just uglier, end of story.</hl> I'll keep my old one until it dies.

A local bakery has won a regional award for its sourdough.
<hl>The bakery has been open since 1952, making it the oldest in the county.</hl> The owner said the recipe has barely changed in seventy years.

Quick question for the gardeners here.
<hl>Does anyone know whether tomatoes can survive a light frost?</hl> Mine are still outside and the forecast looks cold.

I tried the new trail along the river last weekend.
<hl>Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level, which is why my camp stove took longer up in the hills.</hl> Bring extra fuel if you plan to cook at the top.

The school announced a change to its lunch menu.
<hl>Parents reported that children eat more vegetables when meals are served buffet-style, citing a survey of 40 families run by the parents' association.</hl> The school will trial the new format for one term.

My neighbour keeps saying the moon landing was staged.
<hl>He insists the flag could not have moved because there is no wind on the moon, and says a friend of his saw the studio.</hl> I don't even know where to start with him.

Spring cleaning tips, part three.
<hl>Vinegar removes limescale because its acid dissolves calcium carbonate.</hl> Leave it on the kettle element for an hour, then rinse well.

The football club confirmed a new coach for next season.
<hl>Ticket sales have gone up every year since the stadium was renovated, the club said, pointing to its annual report.</hl> Fans have mixed feelings about the choice of coach. The annual report, published in June, lists attendance by season, though it does not separate season tickets from single-match sales. Supporters' groups have asked the club to publish monthly figures so that the effect of the renovation can be checked independently. The club says it will consider the request after the season starts. Local businesses near the stadium report busier match days, and the council has added extra buses on weekends. Critics note that the renovation coincided with the team's promotion, which also tends to raise attendance, so the club's explanation may not be the whole story.

Thinking of adopting a cat.
<hl>Cats are better pets than dogs, no question.</hl> They're quieter and don't need walks.

A short history of our street.
<hl>The old mill at the end of the road was converted into flats in 1998, according to the planning records kept at the town hall.</hl> Some of the original beams can still be seen in the stairwell.

Health officials issued advice ahead of the heatwave.
<hl>Drinking water regularly helps the body regulate its temperature during hot weather.</hl> Officials also recommended checking on elderly neighbours.

Welcome to the weekly quiz thread!
<hl>What is your favourite board game, and why?</hl> Answers in the comments.

Facts about our solar system.
<hl>The Earth orbits the Sun once a year.</hl> The other planets take longer or shorter depending on their distance.
